row.notes: Returns a ref-counted string by low byte of digits and language id 0x145f9aa50: language 6 maps 3 -> 0x146ca3bc8, 4..7 -> 0x146ca3bd0, 8..9 -> 0x146ca3be0; other languages map 3..5 -> 0x146ca3bc8, 6..8 -> 0x146ca3bd8, 9 -> 0x146ca3be8; anything else builds a 7-char literal from 0x145a64e33. Increments the refcount (+4) and stores the pointer in *out_str. The three number formatters call it right after formatting the scaled value (0x1441f0f60 with 0x1456f95b4) and pass the result to Ne_InternedString_Manage as the magnitude suffix argument. Swap the globals to change K/M style suffix text. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
